title: Warm Warped Throats
summary: We investigate brane inflation, focusing on warm inflation realizations within a warped throat geometry. While the standard scenario relies on a single mobile $D3$-brane moving radially toward an anti-$D3$-brane at the throat's tip, we propose two distinct single-field inflationary pictures. In our approach, the radial and angular coordinates of a $D3$-brane on a warped deformed conifold act as two independent inflaton fields. We address moduli stabilization by incorporating a supersymmetrically embedded $D7$-brane, which generates the necessary radial and angular scalar potentials.…
